words.gloss_range: opening particle of futility, locally negative or rhetorical-interrogative, scoping the whole availing clause and its two resource subjects
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) makes futility arrive before any resource is named. It can be heard as direct negation or as a rhetorical question whose answer is nothing; the possible exclamatory pressure is best kept as evaluative force rather than as the controlling parse. Because the particle opens the clause, both the named wealth and the later earned-gain phrase remain under the same failed-availing frame. Its long sound also returns inside the ayah, so the reader hears one compact particle bind the two beats while the grammar shifts at the second occurrence.

topics.headline: opening futility scopes over both resources
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that failure is the starting frame and that both wealth and earned gain are judged inside it.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the opening particle over the one negated verbal clause whose subjects are the named wealth and the coordinated earned-gain phrase.

topics.headline: negative and rhetorical-question readings converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same short surface can deny availing or ask what availing occurred, with both routes producing a null result.
topics.reason: QAC explicitly supports negative and interrogative parsing; exclamatory force is retained only as rhetorical coloring because the local guardrail does not make it the main parse.

topics.headline: long sound links the two beats
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the tiny opening particle is acoustically weighty and returns later with a different grammatical job.
topics.reason: The source rows tie the written long opening and the later repeated sound to the ayah's two-beat resource structure.

words.gloss_range: negated Form IV availing or making sufficient in a protection frame, with no explicit direct object and with the affected person expressed through the following prepositional complement
words.root_gloss_range: self-sufficiency, wealth, sufficing and availing are the relevant local branches; song, dwelling, and marriage-related branches remain nonselected background images or contrasts when pressed by CRITICAL rows
words.prose: {{ar:أَغْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:aghnā}}) is the clause's center: a perfect Form IV verb whose availing has already been negated before the wealth is named. The local frame asks whether a resource could make someone sufficient, protect him, or stand in for him; the prepositional complement carries the exposed person while the direct object is absent, so the failure is not restricted to one named benefit. The root field of sufficiency and wealth is locally active, while dwelling, song, and absolute divine self-sufficiency work only as narrowed contrasts: they intensify the loss of stability or fullness without replacing the availing sense. The wording also belongs to a wider failed-reliance formula (7:48, 11:101, 15:84, 39:50), and it points forward to the fire outcome in 111:3. Even the sound hinge is tight: the guttural opening of the verb meets the constricted onset of the following prepositional complement, matching the protective relation as it collapses.

topics.headline: perfect form makes failure settled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb presents the collapse of availing as already established, not merely pending.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as perfect, and the contextual profile shows this root-form is frequently negated in scoped availing contexts.

topics.headline: availing frame denies any specified protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is not just about wealth helping in general; it tests whether wealth could shield or suffice for him in any unstated measure.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the governed prepositional complement and no direct object, while V4 includes the availing and sufficing construction for this root.

topics.headline: root field tests human sufficiency through wealth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word denies not only a useful transaction but the whole expected state of resource-based sufficiency.
topics.reason: The wealth and sufficiency branches are locally coherent with the verb and its subject; non-surface self-sufficiency forms and proper-name contrast are kept as contrastive pressure, not as replacement senses.

topics.headline: dwelling and song images remain background pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a narrowed image of lost rootedness or fullness while the local verb still means availing or making sufficient.
topics.reason: V4 separates dwelling and song as distinct branches, so they should not be activated as local meanings; they survive only as limited root-family pressure from the CRITICAL rows.

topics.headline: one failed predicate governs two resources
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wealth and earned gain do not receive separate verdicts; one negated verb governs both.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence analyzes the ayah as one verbal clause with the named wealth and the coordinated relative phrase as subjects under the same predicate.

topics.headline: failed-availing formula links outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this personal condemnation participates in a broader failed-reliance formula and prepares the next ayah's consequence.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete parallels and the local attachment evidence supports the failed-availing construction; any commentary mention should keep the references explicit (7:48, 11:101, 15:84, 39:50, 111:3).

topics.headline: sound binds negation, availing, and wealth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb as part of the ayah's audible chain, not only as an abstract predicate.
topics.reason: The sound rows are coherent with the local sequence and do not conflict with grammar; they remain secondary to the semantic frame.

words.gloss_range: governed prepositional complement meaning availing or protection for/against the prior masculine referent, with separation imagery and a bound 3ms suffix
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْهُ}} ({{tr:ʿanhu}}) makes the failed availing personal before the wealth is named. The preposition supplies a separation or shielding frame: the question is whether anything could stand away from him as protection. The suffix silently carries the condemned referent from 111:1, and its placement between the verb and wealth means the exposed person is heard before the failed protector. The repeated suffix in the next word tightens the point: the one needing protection is the same one whose own wealth fails.

topics.headline: suffix carries the prior referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not restart with an unnamed person; the bound suffix keeps the prior condemned figure grammatically present.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the 3ms suffix to the prior proper-name span in 111:1.

topics.headline: preposition frames failed shielding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase concerns failed protection or availing against exposure, not merely a generic benefit granted to him.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence treat the word as the governed complement of the availing verb, with the affected participant expressed through the prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: exposed person appears before failed protector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the experiential order: failure and exposure are heard before the asset that was supposed to protect him.
topics.reason: The local word order places this prepositional phrase between the negated verb and the delayed subject.

topics.headline: bound form compresses relation and referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how a small bound form joins the relation of failed shielding to the person and then echoes into the possessive suffix.
topics.reason: The rows describe form and sound effects that align with the local syntax and repeated suffix chain.

words.gloss_range: his concrete wealth or possessed property, definite by suffix and functioning as the delayed subject that fails to avail
words.root_gloss_range: wealth, property, possession, and acquisition of wealth are locally relevant; any leaning or swaying image remains a narrowed etymological pressure, not the selected noun sense
words.prose: {{ar:مَالُهُۥ}} ({{tr:māluhū}}) finally names the supposed protector, but grammar gives it the role of subject only after failure and exposure have already been heard. The suffix makes the wealth specifically his, tying possessor and exposed beneficiary to the same referent from 111:1. The singular noun gathers the whole property mass into one bounded resource, including tangible goods and livestock-like movable wealth, then the next phrase expands beyond stored possession to what was acquired. CRITICAL rows about leaning or swaying are best kept as narrowed image-pressure: the local sense is wealth, but the image sharpens the irony of a resource asked to stand firm and unable to do so. The failed-wealth motif also resonates with 69:28 and moves toward the household fire imagery of 111:4.

topics.headline: his wealth is tied to the exposed person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failed wealth is not generic wealth but the very wealth of the person already exposed by the pronoun chain.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the suffix as possessive and linked to the same masculine discourse participant.

topics.headline: wealth is the delayed failed actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices wealth being grammatically cast as the actor that should have availed, making its failure more pointed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as the explicit subject of the negated availing verb, delayed after the verb and prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: singular wealth gathers stored assets
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a whole concrete store of property is gathered into one failed subject before the wording widens to earned gain.
topics.reason: QAC and V4 support wealth or property as the local noun range, and the singular possessed form gathers the resource as one unit.

topics.headline: possession is paired with acquisition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an ordered resource pair: what he has and what he acquired both fail under the same predicate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the later relative phrase with this noun as a second subject under the same negated verb.

topics.headline: leaning image undercuts wealth as shield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony of wealth being assigned a protective role while leaning or swaying root-image pressure makes it feel unstable.
topics.reason: The local noun sense remains wealth or property; leaning imagery survives only as narrowed etymological pressure from the CRITICAL evidence, not as the selected meaning.

topics.headline: failed wealth echoes outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this named wealth is part of a wider failed-resource pattern and is linked to the surah's surrounding ruin imagery.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete links to failed wealth in 69:28 and to the surah boundary material in 111:1 and 111:4.

topics.headline: wealth thickens the repeated sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the wealth word as the concrete middle of the ayah's repeated sound frame.
topics.reason: The sound rows align with the local sequence and preserve a secondary acoustic payoff without changing the noun's semantic range.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the earned-gain phrase to wealth under the same negation, functioning locally like a neither/nor extension rather than a restart
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does the expansion work. It prevents the following earned-gain phrase from becoming a new sentence or a mere restatement of wealth; instead, it makes a second subject share the same negated availing predicate. In the negative setting its force is effectively neither/nor: not his wealth, and not what he earned. The fused sound with the following relative word keeps the second beat attached, and the boundary rows show the same conjunctional expansion continuing the movement from 111:1 into 111:2: from hands to person, then from wealth to all earning.

topics.headline: conjunction extends one negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second resource remains under the same failed-availing frame instead of becoming a separate claim.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify strict coordination of the relative phrase with the wealth subject under the existing negation.

topics.headline: wealth expands to all acquired gain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that possession and acquisition remain distinct categories while both are denied availing force.
topics.reason: The conjunction creates a second coordinated subject rather than apposition, preserving the movement from named wealth to open acquisition.

topics.headline: fused form blocks a restart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector and relative word flow as one continuation into the second subject.
topics.reason: The form and recitation rows align with the local syntax, where the second phrase is attached to the first subject under one predicate.

topics.headline: conjunction repeats prior expansion logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same connective expansion operating across the move from 111:1 into the resource list of 111:2.
topics.reason: The boundary rows give concrete 111:1 and 111:2 evidence for repeated conjunctional expansion, while local syntax keeps this instance coordinated inside the negated clause.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun introducing an open earned object and forming a free-relative subject phrase coordinated with wealth; masdar-style product/process pressure is possible but secondary to the local relative parse
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is not the opening negator repeated with the same job. Here it introduces the earned item as an open relative object inside the clause, while the whole relative phrase becomes the second subject under the failed-availing verb. That double role lets the wording treat acquisition as both acted-on gain and a resource that fails. The open reference refuses to specify money, status, offspring, reputation, or deeds, so all acquired categories can be swept in. A masdar-style reading can add process pressure, but local attachment evidence keeps the relative-object parse primary. The repeated sound ties the second beat back to the opening while forcing the reader to track a real grammatical shift.

topics.headline: relative word is object inside and subject outside
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a small relative word turns an earning clause into a resource subject while still serving as the verb's object inside that clause.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the relative pronoun/object of the earning verb and the relative phrase as coordinated subject of the negated availing verb.

topics.headline: open reference maximizes what was earned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording avoids naming a specific acquired thing so the failed category can include every kind of gain.
topics.reason: The local relative pronoun supplies an unspecified object, and translation support warns that the coordinated free relative must remain under the same negated frame.

topics.headline: product reading dominates while process pressure survives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what he earned is primary, while the act of earning itself can also be felt as denied availing force.
topics.reason: The attachment guardrail strongly supports the relative-object parse; masdar-style reading survives only as secondary product/process pressure from the CRITICAL rows.

topics.headline: coordination pivots into a clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second coordinated resource is not another simple noun but an open clause of acquisition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence analyzes the relative construction as the second subject expression, with the earning verb carrying an implicit 3ms subject.

topics.headline: same sound changes grammatical work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated sound binding the ayah while the second occurrence performs a different grammatical function.
topics.reason: The sound rows are supported by the visible repeated form, while QAC distinguishes the first particle from this relative pronoun.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect earning or acquisition, with the relative pronoun as its open object and an implicit 3ms subject tied to the prior referent
words.root_gloss_range: earning, gaining, acquiring, seeking benefit, and incurring liability are relevant; causative gain-for-another, hunting-creature, and substance-name branches are not locally selected
words.prose: {{ar:كَسَبَ}} ({{tr:kasaba}}) closes the ayah with acquisition itself. The verb is perfect, so the earning is presented as completed and available for judgment, not still unfolding. Its subject is hidden in the 3ms form, bringing the same person back as active earner after wealth had been cast as the failed subject. The relative object before it keeps the earned domain open, so ordinary gain, accumulated benefit, and moral liability can all fall under the failed-availing verdict. Form VIII, gathering, and livestock-management pressure should be heard only as narrowed color toward deliberate acquisition, tying earned effort back to concrete wealth without replacing the surface Form I. As the final word, it compresses the second beat and leaves earned gain as the last failed support before 111:3 names the consequence.

topics.headline: open object makes acquisition totalizing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb does not itemize the acquired object, so the failed category remains broad and exhaustive.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the relative pronoun as the object of the earning verb, preserving open reference rather than a separately named object.

topics.headline: hidden subject makes the owner active earner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from wealth as failed actor to the owner himself re-entering as the covert agent of acquisition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks an implicit 3ms subject compatible with the same discourse participant resumed by the suffixes.

topics.headline: perfect Form I closes acquisition as judged
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ordinary acquisition in completed aspect, not intensified earning or an ongoing habit.
topics.reason: QAC gives a Form I perfect verb, and contextual evidence distinguishes the local perfect from broader perfect/imperfect distribution.

topics.headline: earning includes gain and liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that acquisition is not merely income; the open phrase can include accumulated benefit and incurred moral liability.
topics.reason: V4 supports seeking and obtaining livelihood or benefit as the selected branch; moral and gathering pressure survives because the open object does not narrow the acquired domain.

topics.headline: deliberate acquisition colors the surface verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices active accumulation and livestock-management pressure while the canonical surface remains the simple Form I verb.
topics.reason: Variant and concrete-image rows may color deliberateness, but local form evidence keeps the canonical surface as Form I rather than replacing it with another form.

topics.headline: earned gain joins wealth under failed sufficiency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices earned gain as the dynamic counterpart to stored wealth inside the same failed-sufficiency test.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the earned phrase with wealth, and the CRITICAL rows connect this pairing to wider failed-availing formulas such as 15:84 and 39:50.

topics.headline: final verb tightens toward the next verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices acquisition as the ayah's last named failed support before the next ayah supplies the consequence.
topics.reason: The word is final in 111:2, and the CRITICAL rows explicitly connect the failed-resource closure to the outcome in 111:3.

topics.headline: compact ending gives acquisition a clipped landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shorter second beat tightening into the final acquisition verb.
topics.reason: The sound rows are coherent with the final word position and compact second beat; they remain secondary to the lexical and syntactic topics.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated sufficiency verb attaches directly to him, while his wealth is the would-be means.
baseline_models.mechanism: The self-sufficiency branch makes wealth an attempted reduction of need and exposure. Negation leaves possession intact but blocks it from becoming independence.

activation_trace.role: Self-sufficiency and reduced need supply the literal state that the negated verb denies wealth can produce.
Acquired and abundant property supplies the possessed resource that fails to become insulation.

changed_reading.before: His wealth did not benefit him.
changed_reading.after: His owned abundance failed to make him independent or reduce his exposure; possession did not become insulation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: His wealth and whatever he acquired are coordinated under one negated claim of availing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse couples a stock of property with the process and yield of acquisition. The availing branch asks whether either resource can suffice, spare, or stand in for its owner, and the negation rejects the whole stock-flow system as a substitute.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing, sparing, and standing in for another define the failed substitutive function.
Possessed wealth supplies the accumulated stock side of the resource system.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the active flow and yield side of the resource system.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and earnings are two loose items that happened not to help.
changed_reading.after: Accumulated capital and the entire gain-producing process jointly fail to spare or replace the person who owns them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open object of acquisition can probe more than gains retained by the subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch in which acquisition brings gain to someone else opens a form-distant but live reading of an outward benefit network. What fails may include not only private earnings but gains, beneficiaries, or dependencies produced through him.

activation_trace.role: Causing another to receive gain supplies the outward transmission model, though its construction is more specific than the focus form.
Availing or standing in for someone makes the transmitted network relevant as a possible source of rescue.

changed_reading.before: What he earned means only his privately retained proceeds.
changed_reading.after: What he acquired may also probe gains he caused to reach others and the outward network expected to avail him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cutting and loss strike the hands, while hand branches explicitly name ownership and what hands earn. The focus then reads as a post-collapse balance sheet: held capital and agentive output remain legible as categories after the agency behind them has been severed.

activation_trace.role: Possessed property supplies the stock left on the disabled agency's balance sheet.
Obtained gain supplies the output formerly produced by that agency.
Cutting turns the preceding loss into a disabling break rather than a mere decline in asset value.
The owning hand links bodily agency to the focus ayah's possessed wealth.
What the hands earn directly links disabled agency to the focus ayah's acquisition term.

structural_cues: 111:1 repeats the loss verb around the hand and name construction, then 111:2 inventories wealth and acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cutting, the owning hand, and what hands earn; I infer that the two focus resources are residues of a disabled agency. A live alternative is that the hands remain only the object of loss and the next ayah gives an independent reason.

changed_reading.before: A functioning resource system simply proves inadequate.
changed_reading.after: Wealth and acquisition are the surviving entries of an agency already cut off, so their failure is structural rather than a shortage of quantity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split mapping activates hand as force alongside supporting strength and a protective enclosure. Wealth's failed sufficiency therefore expands from purchasing failure to collapse of backing, reinforcement, and shelter.

activation_trace.role: Independence and reduced need define the protected state wealth was expected to create.
Hand as force supplies the dominant mapping's image of effective backing.
The non-dominant mapped root contributes supporting strength as a latent function wealth cannot provide.
The protective enclosure sharpens failed independence into failed shelter.

structural_cues: One source occurrence is deliberately preserved with dominant and non-dominant mapped roots, allowing support and enclosure to coexist with the hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies force, supporting strength, and enclosure from the split mapping; I infer that these functions can specify what wealth failed to do. The non-dominant mapping may instead be only a remote lexical resonance with no syntactic force here.

changed_reading.after: Wealth also failed as backing power and protective shelter: neither force nor enclosure could be converted from possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fatherhood and nurture give social direction to the outward-gain branch. The acquisition term can now probe a legacy or dependent network to which benefit was transmitted, while the negated availing clause denies that this social reproduction can return as rescue.

activation_trace.role: Bringing gain to another supplies the focus-anchored direction from acquirer toward beneficiaries.
Standing in for someone supplies the hoped-for return function that the network fails to perform.
Fatherhood and nurture supply an intergenerational or dependent channel for outwardly transmitted gain.

structural_cues: The paternal title precedes the possessive wealth and implicit acquiring subject, placing personal resources inside a named social identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fatherhood and gain delivered to another; I infer a legacy or dependent network and a failed return of support. A live alternative is that the paternal expression functions only as a fixed identifier and does not activate transmission.

changed_reading.before: The outward-gain reading concerns an unspecified circle of beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: It can specifically include a nurtured legacy or dependent network whose received gains still cannot stand in for its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root is available first as a name or title and later as an actual tongue of flame, with the failed-resource ayah between them. Wealth and acquisition become an attempted buffer between named identity and materialized consequence, but they cannot interpose.

activation_trace.role: Sparing or standing in for the person supplies the buffer function denied in the focus.
The name-or-title branch supplies a socially carried identity before the focus ayah.
The flaming tongue supplies the material condition into which the title is made to resolve.

structural_cues: The repeated root occurs on both sides of 111:2, changing from a personal designation in 111:1 to the quality of fire in 111:3.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the title branch, the flame branch, and their bracketing recurrence; I infer an identity-to-consequence movement with wealth as failed buffer. The alternative is a sharp lexical echo without a causal claim about identity.

changed_reading.before: Wealth cannot avert an external danger.
changed_reading.after: Wealth cannot separate the owner from a danger already folded into his public designation; the title becomes exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Encounter with heat, fire's capacity to straighten or work material, and the branch of conspicuous clarity turn the failed substitution into an exposure test. The stock-flow system is not merely declared useless; contact with the coming condition makes its inability to stand in for the bearer manifest.

activation_trace.role: Standing in for or sparing the bearer defines the capacity tested under exposure.
Accumulated benefit supplies the acquired material whose practical efficacy is being tested.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies direct exposure rather than distant possession.
Fire that works or straightens material supplies the image of a condition that tests and alters what meets it.
Conspicuous clarity supplies the disclosure function: failed efficacy becomes visible.

structural_cues: The completed negated availing in 111:2 is followed by a future encounter in 111:3, so prior accumulation cannot preempt what is coming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat encounter, fire-working, and conspicuous clarity; I infer a test-and-disclosure arrow from exposure to manifest non-substitutability. The live alternative is simple temporal sequence with no assay-like mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse states a static verdict that resources did not help.
changed_reading.after: The coming encounter functions as the condition that exposes why accumulated resources cannot substitute for their bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Marriage as sufficiency or protection meets the wife, carrying as surety or burden, and collected fuel. A household relation that could have been mutual protection reverses into a liability circuit in which the partner carries what intensifies exposure.

activation_trace.role: Marriage as sufficiency and protection supplies the focus-anchored expectation of household shelter.
Gain transmitted to another supplies reciprocal economic circulation inside the relationship.
The woman or wife supplies the concrete relational counterpart that activates the marriage branch.
Surety and guarantee supply the expected protective function of carrying for another.
Bearing a burden or liability reverses guarantee into carried exposure.
Collected fuel gives the carried liability a material function: it feeds rather than blocks the danger.

structural_cues: The possessive relation in his wealth is echoed by his wife, but the latter is grammatically presented as an active carrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marriage-as-protection, wife, surety, burden, and fuel; I infer a reversal from household shelter to reciprocal liability. A live alternative is that the wife is an independently responsible agent rather than a component of his failed resource system.

changed_reading.before: Only individual money and individual earnings fail.
changed_reading.after: Relational capital and household guarantee also fail, and may reverse into a partner-mediated circuit that carries fuel toward the shared exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The night collector who mixes bad and good changes acquisition from successful increase into indiscriminate gathering. Once heterogeneous gains are reduced to one stock, the fuel branch gives that stock a destructive use: quantity accumulates while qualitative discrimination disappears.

activation_trace.role: Possession and abundance supply the growing stock produced by accumulation.
Seeking and obtaining gain supplies the repeated gathering process.
The night collector's mixing of bad and good turns gain-seeking into acquisition without discrimination.
Collected wood as fuel assigns the mixed stock a use that intensifies the threat.

structural_cues: The intensive carrier expression is immediately joined to a gathered material, making collection and transport one repeated process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gain-seeking, mixed collection, and fuel; I infer that indiscriminate accumulation converts heterogeneous acquisitions into combustible stock. The alternative is that the collector image belongs only to the literal fuel scene and does not classify the focus gains.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, vocal or reputational capital also fails and may reverse into speech that feeds the very exposure it was meant to overcome.

strongest_changes: The hand and cutting branches recast wealth and acquisition as a post-collapse balance sheet of disabled agency.
The repeated flame root brackets the focus and turns resources into a failed buffer between public identity and material consequence.
Marriage, surety, burden, and fuel extend the failure from private assets to a household relation that can reverse into liability.
Rope, twist, and neck recast successive acquisitions as strands assembled into constraint and security connection as a bond that controls.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several coexisting resource models: wealth as insulation, as substitute, as stock joined to acquisition flow, and as an outward benefit network. Context does not merely confirm failure; it changes the mechanics through severance, support collapse, title materialization, household reversal, indiscriminate collection, and self-braiding constraint, while the web, hunting, and voice readings remain live under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The outward-gain branch is construction-sensitive, so extending the simple focus verb to beneficiaries or legacy remains exploratory.
The non-dominant hand mapping may reveal latent support and enclosure, but it may also be too remote to bear syntactic weight.
The heat-test and braided-acquisition models infer directional mechanisms from sequence and material analogy rather than receiving those arrows directly from the packet.
The spider, hunting, and vocal branches should remain exploratory resonances and must not be promoted into direct lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wealth fails specifically as substitute protection.** Branch evidence: `غ ن ي` B002, sufficing/availing/replacing; `غ ن ي` B001, wealth and self-sufficiency; `م و ل` B001, acquiring and having property; later `ح ب ل` B002, covenant/protection/connection; `ح م ل` B004, guarantee and indemnity. Structural cue: the denial of availing is followed by a spouse who carries and a rope that may signify protection or bond. Assigned role: wealth is tested as a would-be replacement shield, pledge, or guarantor. Abductive move: I infer that social-legal protection images later in the packet activate what wealth was expected to do. Reading change: the ayah is not simply "money did not help"; it says the whole economy of substitution, guarantee, and protective bond collapses.

2. **What he earned becomes feedstock instead of defense.** Branch evidence: `ك س ب` B001, seeking/obtaining livelihood or benefit; `م و ل` B001, property; later `ح ط ب` B001, firewood gathered as fuel; `ل ه ب` B001, kindled flame; `ص ل ي` B004, kindling/fuel/fire-straightening. Structural cue: gain and property precede the firewood carrier and the flame. Assigned role: earnings supply the acquisition-side of a fuel economy. Abductive move: I supply the transformation arrow: accumulations that were meant to benefit are converted by the later imagery into combustible material. Reading change: "what he earned" is no longer neutral profit; it can be read as stored fuel for the fire-system.

3. **The hands' deeds are separated from the person and then denied efficacy.** Branch evidence: earlier `ي د ي` B009, hands as one's act; `ي د ي` B004, possession; `ك س ب` B001, self-acquisition; `ك س ب` B002, bringing gain to someone else. Structural cue: 111:1 isolates the hands; 111:2 names his property and acquired output; 111:4 shows another person bearing. Assigned role: `كَسَبَ` gathers both personal earning and what one causes to be gained or carried by another. Abductive move: I infer that the wife-carrier later makes "what he earned" socially distributed rather than purely private. Reading change: the ayah reads as judgment on a network of acts and induced acts, not only on private assets.

4. **Settled dwelling is made homeless by non-avail.** Branch evidence: `غ ن ي` B004, dwelling/staying long/former habitations; `م و ل` B001, property; later `ح م ل` B001, transport and outward load; `ح ب ل` B001, leading/binding rope. Structural cue: the wealth statement stands between the perishing person and a moving/carrying scene. Assigned role: the dwelling branch tests whether wealth creates a settled place. Abductive move: I infer a spatial reversal: what seemed to establish him becomes unable to keep him in place. Reading change: the denial of `أَغْنَى` also reads as loss of settled security, not only failure of payment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md:
- 111:4 surprised the reading of `كَسَبَ`: because `حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ` can carry physical fuel and harmful speech (`ح ط ب` B001/B003), "what he earned" no longer reads as a ledger item only. It becomes whatever his agency has put into circulation for others to carry.
- 111:5 made the protection problem more concrete. `ح ب ل` B002 can be covenant, protection, and connection, but it ends as a rope on the neck. That retrospectively clarifies why `أَغْنَىٰ` B002 is denied: no substitute, bond, or guarantor successfully stands between him and the consequence.
- 111:3 also turned property into combustible matter. The movement from `مَالُهُ`/`كَسَبَ` to fire and then to firewood made accumulation itself available to be reread as fuel.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Neither stock nor activity can stand in for the person.** **Lexical evidence:** `أَغْنَى` has root `غ ن ي`, branch `B002` (sufficing, availing, sparing, or replacing); `مَالُهُ` has root `م و ل`, branch `B001` (acquired wealth); and `كَسَبَ` has root `ك س ب`, branch `B001` (seeking and obtaining gain). **Structure:** the repeated negator `مَا ... وَمَا` balances stored property against productive action, while `عَنْهُ` places both in a failed substitutive relation to him. `111:3` then retains him as the future subject who encounters the fire. **Role and abduction:** grammar and branch scopes supply the candidates for substitution; I infer that the fire's unchanged subject proves their failure to take his place or spare him. **Reading change:** `أَغْنَى عَنْهُ` means more than “did not help”: nothing owned or performed can become an effective surrogate.

2. **Marital sufficiency is included in the failed household economy.** **Lexical evidence:** root `غ ن ي`, branch `B006`, explicitly includes marriage as sufficiency or protection; the later `وَٱمْرَأَتُهُ` supplies the spousal relation, while `حَمَّالَةَ` (`ح م ل`, branch `B004`) can denote guarantee or indemnity. **Structure:** the wife enters immediately after the man's fire sentence, not as an external rescuer but as another participant bearing a load. **Role and abduction:** marriage and surety are supplied branch possibilities; I infer that the negated sufficiency extends from money into household protection, and that her “guaranteeing” role only joins her to the liability. **Reading change:** the ayah denies not just financial insulation but the capacity of the marital unit to indemnify its central figure.

3. **Accumulation reverses into combustible liability.** **Lexical evidence:** `مَالُهُ`, root `م و ل`, branch `B001`, is property amassed as possession; `كَسَبَ`, root `ك س ب`, branch `B001`, is benefit deliberately obtained. Later `حَطَب`, root `ح ط ب`, branch `B001`, is material gathered as fuel, and `ص ل ي`, branch `B004`, supplies kindling/fire-use. **Structure:** acquisition vocabulary is followed by a concrete supply sequence: fire, a carrier, gathered fuel, and carrying cord. **Role and abduction:** the packet supplies accumulation and fuel collection; I infer the conversion arrow by which gathered means cease to shield and instead become inputs to the destructive system. **Reading change:** the negation exposes an inversion of value: what counts as gain at acquisition can count as fuel at consequence.

4. **Exploratory: the earner becomes the caught quarry.** **Lexical evidence:** root `ك س ب`, branch `B003`, calls predatory or hunting creatures “earners”; `111:5` supplies `حَبْل`, root `ح ب ل`, branch `B005` (a snare that catches), while `يَدَا` in `111:1`, root `ي د ي`, branch `B001`, includes a hand caught in a snare. **Structure:** the packet begins with active hands, moves through earning, and ends with bodily entanglement. **Role and abduction:** hunting and snaring images are lexically supplied, but I infer the reversal from acquirer/predator to captured household. This remains exploratory because `كَسَبَ` is not itself a hunting construction. **Reading change:** earning can be heard as a capture strategy whose terminal effect is to capture its own agentive system.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `111:4` unexpectedly activated `غ ن ي` branch `B006`: the explicit wife made marriage itself one of the sufficiency/protection systems negated by `أَغْنَى`, while her load made that system a liability rather than a refuge. `111:3–4` also corrected “wealth did not help” into a value-reversal, because acquisition is followed by gathered fuel. Finally, the snaring cord of `111:5` made the otherwise remote hunting-creature branch of `ك س ب` (`B003`) visible as an exploratory predator-to-captive reversal.

findings.text: Mal ve kazanım, kişinin yerine geçecek bir bedel, güvence ya da koruyucu bağ olamaz; sonuç yine doğrudan ona ulaşır.
Eşin sonraki yük taşıyan konumu, geçersiz kalan yeterliliğin evlilik ve hane korumasını da kapsadığını gösterir.
Birikmiş mal ve kazanç, sonraki ateş ve odun dizisinde koruyucu sermaye olmaktan çıkıp yıkımı besleyen yanıcı girdiye dönüşür.
Kazanılan şey, yalnız kişisel varlık değil, başkasına taşıttırılan ve dolaşıma sokulan eylemlerin sonucu olarak da genişler.
Yerleşme çağrışımı, malın kişiye kalıcı bir güvenlik ve sabit yer sağlayamadığı mekânsal bir tersine dönüş önerir.
Avcı kazancı çağrışımı ile son bağın tuzak işlevi birleştirildiğinde, elde eden kişinin kendi edinme düzenince yakalandığı düşünülebilir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same hand that marks culpable action can also denote favor, direct exchange, skilled work, and protective aid.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hands, Earnings, and Failed Sufficiency
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person's acts and acquisitions are gathered under the agency of his hands, yet neither accumulated property nor earned gain averts destruction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ruin and loss `ت ب ب:B001/m01`; deeds attributed to the hands `ي د ي:B009/m01`; self-directed earning `ك س ب:B001/m01`; accumulated property `م و ل:B001/m01`; sufficiency and utility `غ ن ي:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The hands function as the accountable source of action, while wealth and earning are the expected means of self-preservation. Their failure to suffice turns economic agency into an outcome-bearing scene: what was acquired remains attached to the agent but cannot rescue him from the ruin attached to his own hands.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human capacity becomes visible through hands that acquire, control, transfer, and answer for what they do.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same hand that marks culpable action can also denote favor, direct exchange, skilled work, and protective aid.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Transfer, Favor, and Protective Aid
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Goods or benefits pass from one agent to another through direct transfer, benefaction, and an assisting hand.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: favor bestowed by hand `ي د ي:B003/m01`; hand-to-hand exchange `ي د ي:B007/m01`; gain procured for another `ك س ب:B002/m01`; practical sufficiency `غ ن ي:B002/m01`; supporting and protecting hand `ي د ي:B016/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Acquisition is not confined to self-enrichment: it can be redirected as a benefit secured for someone else. The favoring, exchanging, and protecting hand forms a transfer scene in which agency is measured by what it places within another person's reach.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human capacity becomes visible through hands that acquire, control, transfer, and answer for what they do.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same hand that marks culpable action can also denote favor, direct exchange, skilled work, and protective aid.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Skilled Labor and Accumulated Means
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Manual skill produces gain, and repeated gain becomes stored property and material independence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: skilled handcraft `ي د ي:B015/m01`; self-directed earning `ك س ب:B001/m01`; accumulated property `م و ل:B001/m01`; material wealth `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; independence from need `غ ن ي:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The skilled hand supplies the productive operation, earning records its return, and property preserves that return as durable means. Against the surface denial of wealth's saving force, the lexical scene isolates the ordinary labor-to-capital sequence whose expected protection fails.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An extended attachment joins things together, secures a relation, or closes around a target as a constraint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: A physical line can become a covenant that protects, a trust that must be carried, or a snare whose connection is hostile rather than sustaining.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Snare, Pitfall, and Cunning Capture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A concealed line or trap intercepts a quarry, while cunning reproduces the mechanism at the level of human danger.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hunting snare `ح ب ل:B005/m01`; figurative deadly entanglement `ح ب ل:B005/m02`; set hunting trap `ص ل ي:B005/m01`; cunning ruse `ح ب ل:B011/m02`; hand caught in a snare `ي د ي:B001/m02`; predatory limbs `ك س ب:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The line is arranged before contact, the quarry's own movement closes the trap, and predatory limbs complete the seizure. Cunning extends this physical mechanism into a social pitfall in which apparent connection becomes the means of capture.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A household persists by forming unions, provisioning shared life, generating children, nurturing them, and locating them within a named descent group.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Terms for flame and cord also produce personal names, lineage labels, gestation, and descent, linking physical continuity with continuity of identity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Marriage, Dwelling, and Ceremonial Provision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A union is established through marriage, marked by feeding, and sustained by residence, ample living, and material means.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: marriage and bridal establishment `غ ن ي:B006/m01`; socially self-sufficient married woman `غ ن ي:B005/m01`; ceremonial feeding `م ر ء:B004/m02`; settled dwelling `غ ن ي:B004/m01`; ample living `ي د ي:B014/m01`; material wealth `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; household property `م و ل:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Marriage initiates the household, feeding publicly marks its establishment, and dwelling turns the event into continued shared life. Ample means and property provide the ordinary material conditions under which that continuity is expected to hold.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Flock Feeding and Animal Care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fodder plants and processing byproducts feed herd animals whose age, movement, marking, and illness require attention.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: camel-fodder plant `ص ل ي:B010/m01`; young lamb `ح م ل:B009/m01`; thorn-foraging animal `ح ط ب:B001/m04`; pressed oilcake `ك س ب:B004/m01`; livestock scent sickness `ء ب و:B003/m01`; aged or sore-backed pack animal `ت ب ب:B003/m02`; fire-branding of livestock `ن و ر:B002/m02`; skittish animal flight `ن و ر:B006/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Plant growth and press residue become feed, while the lamb and foraging camel supply the herd participants. Branding identifies the animals, skittish movement complicates handling, and scent-borne sickness introduces the practical vulnerability of the managed flock.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Grinding, Storage, Feeding, and Digestion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Food is reduced on a grinding surface, stored in a skin vessel, served, swallowed through the esophagus, and judged by its digestibility and sufficiency.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: grinding slab `ص ل ي:B009/m01`; cooking or roasting by fire `ص ل ي:B004/m02`; pressed oil residue `ك س ب:B004/m01`; skin vessel for fat or honey `م س د:B004/m01`; eating `م ر ء:B004/m01`; ceremonial feeding `م ر ء:B004/m02`; esophagus `م ر ء:B005/m01`; palatable food `م ر ء:B003/m01`; easy digestion `م ر ء:B003/m02`; bodily sufficiency `غ ن ي:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mechanical reduction and storage prepare food for a social act of serving and a bodily act of ingestion. Palatability, passage, digestion, and sufficiency describe successive tests by which stored material becomes actual nourishment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A person is configured through linked anatomy, bodily condition, visible presentation, and the conduct by which that presentation becomes social character.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Tendons, dry wood, braided cord, and flame become models for bodily linkage, emaciation, slender form, hair, and striking beauty.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Neck Adornment, Hair, and Visible Beauty
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A graceful neck carries ornament, while hair, garment, bodily form, and modest bearing compose an admired appearance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: graceful long neck `ج ي د:B001/m02`; necklace ornament `ح ب ل:B008/m01`; striking beauty `ل ه ب:B008/m01`; abundant hair `ل ه ب:B008/m02`; well-formed hair `م س د:B007/m01`; beautiful young woman `غ ن ي:B005/m02`; roomy garment `ي د ي:B014/m02`; modest aversion `ن و ر:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The neck is both anatomical support and a display surface for jewelry, while hair, garment, and proportion extend that display across the person. Modest withdrawal supplies a behavioral frame around visible allure, joining presentation to social demeanor.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech positions an addressee or referent, modulates the voice, and changes social relations through blessing, curse, song, inquiry, or harmful report.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Gathering mixed wood at night becomes a model for indiscriminate or overabundant speech, while carrying wood becomes the circulation of slander.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Song and Voiced Recitation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The voice is shaped into song or softened, affective recitation and can enter a ritual setting.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: singing and melody `غ ن ي:B003/m01`; modulated recitation `غ ن ي:B003/m02`; ritual prayer `ص ل ي:B001/m01`; blessing and intercession `ص ل ي:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Vocal modulation transforms ordinary speech into patterned sound, while prayer gives that patterned voice an address and purpose. Song, softened reading, and blessing meet as controlled uses of breath and tone.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Scenes become navigable by fixing an occasion, marking what lies ahead, identifying a place, and ordering one mover behind another.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Flame becomes the image of a dust-raising gallop, while the prayer root names the racer immediately following the leader.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dwellings, Waymarks, and Starting Positions
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler or competitor is located by dwelling, landscape ridge, visible marker, named place, and a fixed station before departure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dwelling and former habitation `غ ن ي:B004/m01`; elongated sand ridge `ح ب ل:B003/m01`; route marker or boundary `ن و ر:B005/m01`; elevated beacon `ن و ر:B005/m02`; named place `ح ب ل:B009/m01`; race starting station `ح ب ل:B009/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Dwelling provides a stable point of residence, ridges and beacons make the surrounding terrain legible, and the starting station fixes a departure point. The same spatial system can orient travel or organize a formal race.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, eşi veya güzelliği sayesinde takı ve süslenmeye ihtiyaç duymadığı düşünülen kadın açıklamasını güçlü biçimde destekler; ancak bütün tanımlar bu sınırı korumaz. Bazı kullanımlar genç evli kadın, güzel genç kadın, evli olsun olmasın güzel kadın, hatta genel olarak kadın düzeyine kadar genişler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Süsten bağımsız sayılma ana açıklamadır, fakat sözcük her kaynakta aynı koşulları taşımaz; gençlik, güzellik, evlilik ve genel kadın kullanımları ayrı sınır çeşitleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın kadın nitelemesine bağlıdır; eşi, güzelliği, gençliği veya evliliği anlatan sınır çeşitleri korunur ve başka dallardaki evlenme olayına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Eşi sayesinde takıya gerek duymadığı veya güzelliği nedeniyle süslenmeye ihtiyaç duymadığı düşünülen kadını anlatan bir nitelemedir. Kullanım sınırı bazı kaynaklarda genç evli kadın, güzel genç kadın, evli olsun olmasın güzel kadın, hatta genel olarak kadın olacak kadar genişler.

facets.statement: Kadın, eşi veya kendi güzelliği sayesinde takı ve süslenmeye ihtiyaç duymayan biri olarak nitelenir.
Nitelemenin sınırı gençlik, güzellik veya evlilik koşullarından yalnızca birine dayanabilir.
En geniş kaynak kullanımında niteleme belirli bir koşul aranmadan genel olarak kadına uygulanabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kadın nitelemesinde birleşir, fakat sınırı farklı kurar: eşi veya güzelliği nedeniyle süse ihtiyaç duymama ana açıklamadır; gençlik, güzellik, evlilik ve koşulsuz kadın kullanımları daha geniş çeşitlerdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü evlenmeyi, gelinleri evlendirmeyi ve evliliğin bekâr kişi için koruyucu bir durum sayılmasını aynı dalda açıkça verir. Kadın nitelemesi, maddi zenginlik ve sesle ezgi anlamları bu çekirdeğin parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ad ve ettirgen biçimlerin evlenme ile evlendirme anlamlarını kapsar; düğün töreni, eşin kendisi veya evliliğin sonraki aşamaları eklenmez.

Evlilik, bekâr kişi için koruma sağlayan bir güvence olarak değerlendirilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sahip olunan değerli varlıkları ve bunların çoğulunu; kişinin kendisi için varlık edinmesini, varlığının çoğalmasını ya da varlıklı duruma gelmesini ve başkasını varlık sahibi kılmasını birlikte aktarır. Göçebe toplulukların varlığının hayvan sürüleriyle somutlaşması bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı bir özelleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca para ya da birikmiş değer değildir; varlığın kendisini, edinilmesini, artmasını, varlıklı duruma geçişi ve başkasına varlık kazandırmayı ayırarak kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel varlık ve varlık edinme çekirdeğini ayrı tutar; göçebe toplulukların hayvan sürülerini varlık sayan kullanımını yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı özelleşme olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin sahip olduğu değerli varlıkların bütünü ile bunları edinme, çoğaltma ya da bunlara sahip duruma gelme alanıdır. Ayrıca başkasını varlık sahibi kılmayı kapsar; göçebe topluluklara özgü kullanımda sahip olunan varlık özellikle hayvan sürüleridir.

facets.statement: Kişinin sahip olduğu ve değer taşıyan varlıkların bütünü bu dalın ad çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Göçebe toplulukların varlığına ilişkin belirli kullanımda bu varlık, hayvan sürüleriyle somutlaşır.
Kişinin kendisi için değerli varlık edinmesi ve onu kalıcı sahiplik konusu yapması eylem çekirdeğidir.
Kişinin varlığının çoğalması ya da onun varlık sahibi bir duruma geçmesi ayrı bir süreç görünümüdür.
Bir başkasına değerli varlık vererek onu varlık sahibi duruma getirmek, çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısıdır.
Bir kimsenin varlığının çokluğuna şaşma bildiren söyleyiş, artış ve bolluk görünümüne bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, sahip olunan değerli varlıkları ve bunların çoğulunu temel alır; varlık edinme, varlığın çoğalması, varlıklı duruma gelme ve başkasını varlık sahibi kılma süreçlerini bu temel çevresinde birleştirir.
